mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.component, m.perms, m.icon, m.sort_order, m.visible, m.status FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = 0 AND r.status = '0' AND m.status = '0' AND m.visible = '0' AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.menu_id
